page.metaDescription: Support for BCSentinel, pilot onboarding, and technical questions for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.
page.title: Resolve technical questions with clear context.
page.lead: Use support for concrete incidents, access issues, scan questions, or pilot onboarding. General product and demo enquiries belong on the contact page.

heroAside.title: Before contacting support
heroAside.text: Review documentation, scan status, connection test, and product access.

heroAside.title: Helpful details
heroAside.text: Include tenant, environment, company context, run ID, timestamp, and exact error message.

heroAside.title: No public SLA commitment
heroAside.text: No fixed public response time or availability guarantee is currently published.

sections.title: What support can help with
sections.lead: The channel is intended for concrete technical and access-related questions.

cards.title: Connection and registration
cards.text: API connection, registration, tenant mapping, or access snapshot errors.

cards.title: Scans and results
cards.text: Questions about run status, missing results, findings, dashboard, or Executive Report.

cards.title: Products and access
cards.text: Issues with Assessment, Validation, or Monitoring activation and term.

sections.title: These details speed up analysis
sections.lead: Do not send passwords, complete tokens, or unnecessary personal data.

cards.title: Technical context
cards.text: Business Central version, environment, affected company, and incident time.

cards.title: References
cards.text: Run ID, finding code, HTTP status, or exact wording of the error.

cards.title: Reproduction steps
cards.text: Describe the action taken and the expected result.

sections.title: Check these items first
sections.lead: Many causes can be narrowed down without support access.

cards.title: Connection test
cards.text: Validate API URL, HTTPS, and token configuration through the extension.

cards.title: Scan history
cards.text: Review run status, heartbeat, completion, or failure state.

cards.title: License refresh
cards.text: Reload product status, credits, and access from the backend.

sections.title: Use the right channel for your request
sections.lead: This helps route the request with the right context.

cards.title: Technical support
cards.text: Use the contact form with Support selected or email support@bcsentinel.com.

cards.title: Pilot and onboarding
cards.text: For guided implementation, sandbox acceptance, and first customer scans.

cards.title: Product and partnership
cards.text: Use the contact page for demos, pricing, partner programme, or general collaboration.
